strategies.name: FUT_TS_MOM_12M_LS
strategies.thesis: Time-series momentum over 12 months captures persistent trends in futures as per Moskowitz et al. 2012.
strategies.signal_construction: Lookback 12 months for price return; enter long if return > 0, short if return < 0; exit and rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Focuses strictly on 12-month momentum with inverse-vol weighting, unlike live emitters which may use shorter lookbacks or lack vol adjustment.
strategies.fail_mode: Momentum crashes during sharp market reversals or regime shifts.

strategies.name: FUT_TS_MOM_9M_LO
strategies.thesis: A 9-month momentum long-only variant reduces drawdowns by avoiding short positions while capturing trend upside.
strategies.signal_construction: Lookback 9 months for price return; enter long if return > 0, skip if return <= 0; exit and rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Long-only focus with shorter 9-month lookback to reduce exposure to prolonged downturns, unlike mixed long-short live strategies.
strategies.fail_mode: Misses out on short-side profits during sustained bear markets.

strategies.name: FUT_COT_MOM_12M_LS
strategies.thesis: Combining CFTC COT net positioning with 12-month momentum filters out false signals by aligning with commercial hedger trends.
strategies.signal_construction: Lookback 12 months for price return and COT net commercial positions; enter long if return > 0 and COT net commercial > 0, short if return < 0 and COT net commercial < 0; exit and rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Incorporates COT data as a sentiment filter, unlike pure price-based live emitters.
strategies.fail_mode: COT data lag or misinterpretation of hedger intent during speculative bubbles.

strategies.name: FUT_VOL_ADJ_MOM_6M_LO
strategies.thesis: A 6-month momentum long-only strategy with strict volatility adjustment minimizes drawdowns by scaling exposure dynamically.
strategies.signal_construction: Lookback 6 months for price return, calculate 20-day realized vol; enter long if return > 0 with position size inverse to vol; exit and rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Shorter 6-month lookback with explicit vol-scaling for risk control, unlike static weighting in live emitters.
strategies.fail_mode: Volatility spikes could overly reduce exposure during profitable trends.

killers: FUT_SHORT_TERM_REV (Current live emitter with WR 5.9% and PF 0.00; fails to capture trends and lacks academic grounding, should be replaced with momentum-based strategies.)
single_most_important_finding: Academic edge in futures momentum (low MDD in long-only) likely failed to materialize live due to overly short lookbacks or lack of volatility adjustment in existing emitters.
